public_rationale: Marcus explicitly said 'as far as I know'. Staffing and AI deployment records cannot establish the limits of his knowledge. The cited staffing report supplies context but proves neither worldwide absence of replacement nor his awareness of any case. Scoring an unqualified claim that no radiologist anywhere had been replaced would remove his hedge. Under the rule for claims that cannot be independently checked as worded, this claim is not adjudicable.
limitations: This does not establish whether any radiologist actually had been replaced by AI.
No inference about honesty or diligence follows from the inability to verify personal knowledge.

statement.excerpt: Nine years post Hinton, we still haven’t replace a single radiologist, as far as I know.
statement.document_title: Nobel Prizes and The AI Hype Hall of Fame

from_speaker: we still haven’t replace a single radiologist
our_interpretation: The statement expressly limits the assertion to Marcus's knowledge at publication on March 9, 2025. It does not assert an independently verified worldwide absence of replacement.
Replacement ordinarily means AI displacing a radiologist's job or entire professional role. Automating particular readings or reducing workload does not by itself establish this.

The historical reference extends from Hinton's prediction in 2016 through publication. January 1 is used only as the lower boundary of the named year; the supplied text gives no exact prediction date.
Public staffing and deployment records can test whether replacement occurred, but cannot by themselves establish what Marcus knew. Removing that qualification would change the claim.
criteria.support_condition: Independent evidence establishing that no qualifying replacement occurred throughout the referenced period would support the factual component. A search finding no examples does not establish either worldwide absence or the boundaries of Marcus's knowledge.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented replacement during the referenced period, together with reliable contemporaneous evidence that Marcus knew of it by March 9, 2025. A replacement record alone would not contradict the express knowledge qualification.
